Welcome to MicroPyzzotMet’s documentation!

MicroPyzzotMet is a Python library for downscaling meteorological variables (e.g. temperature, radiation, humidity, precipitation) using DEMs and reanalysis data such as ERA5-Land, with a focus on snow and mountain applications.
